perplexity.note: Persistent FastMCP server (lem-mcp-perplexity.service) exposing Perplexity-backed research + fact_check tools. Bound to loopback; only host-side claude instances use it.

playwright.note: Headless, isolated browser for UI work and gauntlet-loop visual critique. The absolute node path is REQUIRED: /usr/bin/npx here is Node 18 and Playwright's MCP server refuses to start below Node 20 -- silently, so an un-pinned command leaves agents with no browser and no error. Touches neither the Selenium pool nor LinkedIn.
